source: US Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board investigation pages (csb.gov), read 2026-11-06
note: facts as the CSB page states; lessons and design_steps are the toolkit's mapping (steps = rows of docs/DESIGN_AWARENESS.md section 1)

incidents.name: BP America Texas City refinery explosion
incidents.lesson: isomerisation unit restart: distillation tower flooded and overpressurised, geyser from a vent stack near occupied trailers: level protection, blowdown to a closed system, siting of occupied buildings
incidents.note: CSB also issued reports on management of change and positive material verification

incidents.name: Kleen Energy natural gas explosion
incidents.recommendation: ASME 2010-07-I-CT-3: require inherently safer fuel gas piping cleaning methods in B31.1 instead of natural gas blows
incidents.lesson: high-pressure natural gas (about 650 psi) used to blow debris from new piping found an ignition source: choose a method that removes the fuel from the activity

incidents.name: Tesoro Anacortes refinery fatal explosion and fire
incidents.recommendation: API 2010-08-I-WA-10: revise API RP 941, Steels for Hydrogen Service at Elevated Temperatures
incidents.lesson: a nearly forty-year-old heat exchanger failed catastrophically while a maintenance step switched streams between exchanger banks: damage-mechanism assessment and aging-asset integrity

incidents.name: T2 Laboratories reactive chemical explosion
incidents.recommendation: ABET 2008-03-I-FL-3: add reactive hazard awareness to chemical engineering curricula
incidents.lesson: runaway during production of a gasoline additive: reactive hazard screening and relief for runaway are design inputs, not afterthoughts

incidents.name: Imperial Sugar dust explosion and fire
incidents.recommendation: American Bakers Association 2008-05-I-GA-8: promote combustible dust hazard awareness and control
incidents.lesson: massive accumulations of sugar dust throughout the packaging building fuelled the explosion: dust hazard analysis, housekeeping and explosion protection by design

incidents.name: D.D. Williamson catastrophic vessel failure
incidents.lesson: a process vessel became overpressurised and failed, releasing aqueous ammonia: pressure relief on every vessel that can be overpressured
incidents.note: the CSB announcement URL text cites lack of emergency relief valves; the report body was not read

incidents.name: Caribbean Petroleum (CAPECO) refinery tank explosion and fire
incidents.recommendation: API 2010-02-I-PR-7: revise ANSI/API 2350 to require automatic overfill prevention systems at bulk aboveground tanks storing flammable liquids with NFPA 704 rating 3 or higher
incidents.lesson: tank overfill and vapour cloud: independent automatic overfill protection, not operator vigilance

incidents.name: West Fertilizer explosion and fire
incidents.lesson: twelve volunteer firefighters and two members of the public killed: hazard communication to responders and siting of facilities relative to the community
incidents.note: deaths = 12 firefighters + 2 public, as the page states

incidents.name: Williams Olefins plant explosion and fire
incidents.recommendation: API 2013-3-I-LA-4: strengthen API 521 for a pressure vessel in a special operating status
incidents.lesson: a pressure vessel in a special operating status ruptured (per the recommendation to strengthen API 521): relief and depressuring should cover non-routine operating modes

incidents.name: Chevron Richmond refinery fire
incidents.recommendation: API 2012-03-I-CA-26: revise API RP 939-C on sulfidation corrosion for low-silicon carbon steel piping
incidents.lesson: release of flammable vapour; the recommendation concerns sulfidation corrosion of low-silicon carbon steel piping: material selection and inspection for damage mechanisms
incidents.note: CSB issued interim, regulatory and final reports

incidents.name: Arkema Crosby chemical plant fire
incidents.lesson: flooding from Hurricane Harvey disabled refrigeration; organic peroxides in trailers warmed and spontaneously combusted: loss of utilities and natural hazards in the design basis for temperature-sensitive materials
incidents.note: 1.5 mile evacuation; the page does not state casualties

incidents.name: Didion Milling explosion and fire
incidents.recommendation: Didion Milling 2017-07-I-WI-1: engage a third party to develop a combustible dust process safety management system modelled on OSHA PSM
incidents.lesson: combustible dust explosions killed five of 19 night-shift employees: dust PSM, hazard analysis and explosion protection

incidents.name: Philadelphia Energy Solutions refinery fire and explosions
incidents.recommendation: API 2019-04-I-PA-4: update API RP 751 on hydrofluoric acid alkylation, including protection of critical safeguards
incidents.lesson: vapour release in an alkylation unit ignited and caused multiple explosions: protect safeguards from the hazard they guard against

incidents.name: Intercontinental Terminals tank fire
incidents.recommendation: API 2019-01-I-TX-6: update API STD 2610 on terminal and tank facilities
incidents.lesson: massive tank fire at a terminal: tank farm layout, remote isolation, fire protection
incidents.note: page status text says ongoing although a 2023 final report is listed

incidents.name: TPC Port Neches explosions and fire
incidents.recommendation: American Chemistry Council 2020-02-I-TX-4: butadiene guidance on identifying and eliminating dead legs and the popcorn polymer hazard
incidents.lesson: dead legs in butadiene service allow runaway popcorn polymer: line design and spare-equipment isolation

incidents.name: BP-Husky Oregon (Toledo) refinery chemical release and fire
incidents.recommendation: API 2022-01-I-OH-5: develop or revise a publication such as API RP 556 on instrumentation (text partly captured)
incidents.lesson: naphtha entered the fuel gas system during an upset and ignited: overfill/level safeguards, relief basis, and PHA accuracy (see also OSHA findings in DESIGN_AWARENESS.md)

incidents.name: PEMEX Deer Park hydrogen sulfide release
incidents.recommendation: ASME 2024-05-I-TX-4: develop written guidelines for marking equipment (text partly captured)
incidents.lesson: workers removing an isolation blind from piping that normally carries H2S: positive isolation, marking and permit design
incidents.note: page shows both 2026-02-23 and 'February 23, 2025' as release date; 2026-02-23 used
